personal.name: Swarnika Somvanshi
personal.title: AI Engineer & Full-Stack Developer
personal.bio: Most of my code exists because something annoyed me enough to fix it myself. That's how Mem1 (an AI memory layer for autonomous agents) started, and it's the same instinct behind the RAG pipelines, encrypted knowledge tools, and browser agents scattered across my GitHub. CS student at BITS Pilani, still figuring out how deep the rabbit hole goes — currently somewhere around raw TCP sockets.

philosophy.title: Build Because It Annoys You
philosophy.description: The best tools are born from frustration. If something slows you down, build the fix — that instinct is what separates engineers from users.

philosophy.title: Research-First, Ship-Second
philosophy.description: Understand the problem deeply before writing a single line. Concept-driven development produces systems that actually last.

philosophy.title: Privacy as a Default
philosophy.description: User data should stay with the user. Zero-knowledge design and local-first architecture aren't features — they're table stakes.

philosophy.title: Solo Systems Thinking
philosophy.description: Building full-stack AI systems solo demands understanding every layer. That breadth is a feature, not a liability.
